title: Skill Efficacy Reporting Standard (SERS)
description: Machine-readable receipt for a skill efficacy verdict. A missing number is a typed refusal, never an invented score. The evidence admissibility gate uses that qualified term only.

sers_version.description: SERS vocabulary generation. Receipts from different sers_version values are not comparable.

verdict.description: Operator-facing keep/cut outcome. KEEP = measurably worth its slot; CUT = remove (see cut_sub_reason); CANT_TELL_YET = evidence does not support a keep/cut call.

cut_sub_reason.description: Qualifies CUT. Required non-null iff verdict is CUT; must be null otherwise. subsumed = model already does the task without the skill; no_lift = measured where help was needed and the skill did not deliver; harmful = skill made outcomes measurably worse.

unmeasured_sub_reason.description: Qualifies an UNMEASURED / cannot-score path when applicable. Mirrors UnmeasuredSubReason exactly. null when the receipt is not an unmeasured refusal path (e.g. a measured KEEP or CUT).

value_class.description: Skill value kind. Screen-path CUT(subsumed) is valid only for transformative-lift; other classes route above-bar p0 to CANT_TELL_YET (wrong instrument). null = unclassified.

outcome_type.description: The scoring-oracle kind the record authorises. pass_fail = legacy conjunction oracle; invariant = split invariant + completion oracle. Required for trap-discipline; null on pass_fail records.

wrong_instrument.description: True when a CUT was withheld because value_class is not transformative-lift (wrong instrument for the lift estimand).

declared_synthetic_control.description: True when the skill/effect is a declared synthetic positive control (effect real by construction). Must never be silently omitted when true.

evidence_admissibility.description: Evidence admissibility gate outcome for the evidence backing this receipt. Uses the qualified term only.

status.description: admissible = all cited evidence cleared the evidence admissibility gate; inadmissible = evidence present but gated out of aggregation; mixed = both; not_applicable = no store-backed evidence (prose-only / mechanical).

detail.description: Optional human-readable note on the evidence admissibility ruling.

cost.description: Cost triple: standing / fired / aux tokens. Each leg is a measured non-negative integer or a typed refusal — never an invented score.

instrument_identity.description: Generation stamp for every figure on this receipt. Figures from different instrument identities are visibly non-comparable.

extractor_model.description: Extractor model pin: the model that READ the run artifacts and produced the figures. From sers_version 1.4.0 this names the extraction stage only, never the subject under test — the subject is subject_identity.subject_model. Where no model-based extraction stage ran (a deterministic oracle scored the epochs), record a typed refusal rather than repeating the subject pin. On receipts at 1.3.0 and earlier this field was documented as 'extractor (or subject)': it carries one pin for two roles and which role it names is not machine-readable. Read those receipts through source.prose_path.

prompt_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint (typically SHA-256 hex) of the exact system/prompt bytes used.

schema_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint (typically SHA-256 hex) of the tool/schema (or harness pin) used.

measurements.description: Optional numeric figures. Each present key is either a measured value or a typed refusal.

p0.description: Null-arm (no-skill) pass rate from a Stage-0 screen.

full_pass_rate.description: Full-arm pass rate from a paired run.

null_pass_rate.description: Null-arm pass rate from a paired run (may equal p0 when only a screen ran).

p_win.description: Posterior P(rate above threshold) from the paired fit.

discordance_rate.description: Paired per-epoch discordance rate d-hat (and optional CI in detail).

go_nogo.description: Pre-stated GO/NO-GO apparatus gate when one was registered.

hazard_entry_null.description: Null-arm hazard-entry rate: the fraction of Null epochs where the hazard pattern was entered.

hazard_entry_full.description: Full-arm hazard-entry rate: the fraction of Full epochs where the hazard pattern was entered.

null_completion_rate.description: Null-arm completion rate: the fraction of Null epochs where the completion oracle scored pass.

full_completion_rate.description: Full-arm completion rate: the fraction of Full epochs where the completion oracle scored pass.

silent_violation_rate.description: Silent violation rate: the fraction of epochs where completion held but invariant failed (C=1, I=0).

source.description: Pointer to the prose source this hand-encoded receipt encodes.

prose_path.description: Repo-relative path to the prose source of record.

date.description: ISO date of the underlying result when known.

summary.description: One-paragraph operator-facing summary. Must not invent numbers absent from measurements/cost.

subject_identity.description: Provenance block identifying the subject under test. Required from sers_version 1.1.0 onward; absent on 1.0.0 hand-encoded receipts.

skill_id.description: SHA-256 hex of the exact SKILL.md bytes measured.

harness_version.description: Harness version used to produce this receipt.

implementation_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the oracle module source at ingest time.

subject_model.description: Subject model pin: the model that EXECUTED the epochs, and whose behaviour with and without the skill was compared. Together with skill_id it identifies what was measured. Required from sers_version 1.4.0; absent on 1.3.0 and earlier receipts, where no field recorded it and it cannot be recovered from the receipt alone.

arms.description: Which arms ran: the run's declared arm names. 'null' and 'full' are the two-value vocabulary of the per-clause instrument; a declared-arm (composition) run names its own arms (e.g. the four cells of a factorial, composed as factor_level fragments joined by '__'). A single arm is a string; several arms are an array of unique names.

delivery.description: Value-delivery attribution: which of the skill's two products (description or body) carried the measured value. Required from sers_version 1.2.0 onward; absent on 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 receipts.

exposure.description: Exposure rate in the treated arm: the fraction of epochs where the skill's description was present in the agent's context (the treatment under #384). Distinct from pi_c (invocation / body load). 'value' is the rate; 'passes' and 'epochs' are optional counts.

pi_c.description: Invocation rate over the treated (Full) arm with Clopper-Pearson interval. 'hat' is the point estimate; 'ci_low' and 'ci_high' bound the interval. 'detector' names the versioned detector that produced the invocations count.

channel.description: Which of the skill's two products carried the measured value. 'description_only' = the standing description line was read but the body was never loaded (pi_c = 0 with full exposure); 'body_and_description' = invocations are present so the body was read; 'not_instrumented' = receipts minted before detector v2.

implementation_family.description: Implementation family the skill belongs to and what alternatives were considered. Author-typed; nothing in the codebase computes it.

claim_scope.description: Scope of the behavioral claim and the set of disturbances under which it holds. Author-typed; nothing in the codebase enumerates disturbances.

retest_triggers.description: What triggers a retest of the result. Author-typed.

expiry_state.description: Expiry state of the result, read from the frozen_cases_with_currency VIEW. 'current' = metric version and implementation hash match the current metric version; 'stale' = a newer version exists or the hash mismatches; 'no_current_metric_version' = no audited valid metric version exists.

verdict_scope.description: Registration and provenance block: what was tested, on which model, under which registration. Absent on pre-1.6.0 receipts. A receipt with verdict KEEP must carry model_id, task_family and delivery_mechanism.

model_id.description: Subject model pin from the harness fingerprint (HarnessPin.model).

harness_version.description: Harness version from the harness fingerprint (HarnessPin or equivalent).

fixture_version.description: Fixture SHA set from fixture_shas.json for the task family.

tested_at.description: ISO datetime of the original full validation run.

task_family.description: Registered task family from the run's RegisteredScope (semantics.py).

estimand.description: Registered estimand from the run's RegisteredScope (semantics.py).

delivery_mechanism.description: Registered delivery mechanism from the run's RegisteredScope (semantics.py).

n_per_arm.description: Number of epochs per arm in the original validation run.

margin_pp.description: Pre-registered margin in percentage points for the confidence sequence, or a typed refusal.

cs_lower_bound.description: Lower bound of the confidence sequence from the original validation, or a typed refusal.

placebo_ref.description: Reference to the placebo or synthetic control used.

fixture_id.description: Identifier of the fixture set used in the run.

currentness.description: Separates the verdict from its present validity. A missing currentness at render time reads as STALE / NONE, never as validated.

state.description: Whether the verdict is currently supported: VALIDATED = full re-validation passed; CARRIED_FORWARD = sentinel/canary passed but no full re-run; STALE = sentinel or canary failed, model changed, or max_age elapsed.

basis.description: How the currentness was established: FULL_VALIDATION = a full paired run; SENTINEL_PASS = sentinel and canary checks passed; NONE = no check performed or checks failed.

last_checked_at.description: ISO datetime of the last currentness check.

next_check_due.description: ISO datetime when the next currentness check is due.

max_age_days.description: Maximum age in days before a verdict is considered STALE.

drift_policy.description: Pre-registered policy for the surveillance procedure (sentinel + canary launcher). The procedure itself is a separate ticket.

null_trigger_pp.description: Null-arm pass-rate change in percentage points that triggers a full re-run.

canary_n.description: Number of canary card + Null sentinel pairs in the surveillance window.

full_rerun_on_null_trigger.description: Whether a null-trigger fires a full re-run.

full_rerun_on_canary_failure.description: Whether a canary failure fires a full re-run.

full_rerun_on_model_change.description: Whether a model change without a passed sentinel fires a full re-run.

token_figure.description: A non-negative token count, or a typed refusal. Missing number = typed refusal, never an invented score.

rate_or_refusal.description: A rate in [0, 1] with optional counts, or a typed refusal drawn from UnmeasuredSubReason (plus not_applicable for non-paths).
